title: Copse renderer API protocol
description: The renderer ↔ main API surface (ApiClient in src/preload/api.d.ts) and the IPC channels the preload binds it to. Generated by scripts/gen-api-protocol.mts; do not edit by hand.

label.description: Custom only — presets keep their locked label/base URL.

models.description: Replaces the default model shortlist when present.

archivedAt.description:
When set, the thread is archived: hidden from the sidebar and `@`-thread
catalog, but kept on disk under `~/.copse/workspace/<projectId>/<id>/`.
Soft-hide (not a delete) — restore is a later UI concern.

archives.description:
Archives (zips) the user has attached to this thread, in the order they
were sent. Read the same two ways `videos` is: `read_archive` is only
offered on threads that have one, and the paths are restated in the tool's
description every turn so trimming cannot lose them.

automation.description: Provenance for a task created by a project automation schedule.

contextTrims.description: Populated when history compaction runs during an agent turn (also in JSONL export).

continuationUsed.description:
Machine-initiated new turns already spent in the current turn tree (decision
5, C3). Counts queue-drain continuations (hook send-now, stop / subagent
follow-ups) as they auto-dispatch; when it reaches the cap
(`DEFAULT_CONTINUATION_BUDGET`), `drainMessageQueue` flips a further
machine-originated message to **held** instead of auto-submitting. Reset to 0
when a human action (typed prompt / release) starts a fresh turn tree. The
run seeds the main-process ledger with this so its in-run tighteners (ACP
unfinished-turn recovery / closeout / pre-review / remediation) share one
counter per turn tree.

currentEpoch.description:
Epoch (turn-tree id) of the current, human-initiated turn tree (decision
16). Set when a human submission / release / send-now starts a fresh turn
tree; an async hook's `queueMessage` output carries the epoch of the turn it
was emitted from, and an epoch that no longer matches this is **stale** — its
send-now downgrades to a held queued message instead of aborting an unrelated
turn. The authoritative turn-tree ledger is C3; C2 tracks the current epoch
so the staleness check (decision 16) has a reference point.

draftPrompt.description: Unsubmitted composer text; keeps blank threads visible across switches.

gitBranch.description: Git branch this thread was started on; set on first message and persisted.

messagesLoaded.description:
`false` means this thread's transcript has not been read off disk yet, so an
empty `messages` says nothing about whether the thread has any.

Load-bearing, not cosmetic. `isBlankThread` treats an empty transcript as
"new, unused thread", `pruneBlankThreads` drops those from the store, and
the autosave reconciler then deletes anything that left — so without this
flag a metadata-only load would delete a project's entire history on its
first launch. `undefined` means "loaded" (threads built in memory, and the
demo API's whole threads).

Never persisted: both `metaOf` implementations strip it before writing.

model.description: Per-thread model override; absent means "use the global default".

modelSelections.description: Ordered picker/automatic model changes, mirrored in the thread spine.

pendingMessages.description: Prompts submitted while the agent is running; drained FIFO when idle.

prRefs.description:
GitHub PRs linked from this thread, cached on its metadata.

Derived from PR links in message text plus {@link remoteAgentLink} — that
is, from exactly the transcript a metadata-only load does not read. Caching
the scrape's result here is what lets the sidebar draw its PR chip without
the transcript, and it is refreshed whenever the transcript is in memory
(on append, and on hydration).

queuePaused.description: True while a queued message is being edited; suspends FIFO draining.

reasoning.description:
Per-chat reasoning dial, set from the composer footer. Overrides the level
saved against the model in Settings for this chat's turns only, so "this
one's hard, think harder" does not permanently re-tune the model. Absent
means the model's own saved level applies.

resolvedModel.description:
The concrete model a turn's `model` selector expanded to (e.g.
`auto:…` → `gpt-5.6-terra`). Recorded at resolution time so it survives a
turn that fails before any usage, unlike the live `byModel` usage map.
Absent on threads written before this was captured.

todos.description: Structured task plan for multi-step agent work (updated via update_todos).

unreadAt.description: Latest agent completion that happened while this thread was not selected.

videos.description:
Videos the user has attached to this thread, in the order they were sent.

Recorded on send (not on chip creation), so a video attached and then
removed before sending never counts. Two things read it: `video_frames` is
only offered to the model on threads that have one, and the paths are
restated in the tool's description every turn — the reference block in the
user's message is the only other place they appear, and history trimming
can drop it out from under a long conversation.

workingBrief.description: Persisted parent/explore goal; set on the first user message in the thread.

worktreeChoice.description: Checkout decision captured once when the thread sends its first message.

autoSetup.description:
"Just works" setup for the curated presets (Claude, Cursor): detect
clients, Socket-Firewall-install missing npm adapters, register + detect
models. Safe to call on every ACP settings-tab open (idempotent).

detectAgents.description: Detect known ACP agents installed/running on this device (for the Settings panel).

probeAgent.description:
Probe a configured agent for the models and session (permission) modes it
offers (spawns it, opens a throwaway session). Each selector is `null`
when the agent exposes none of that kind (issue #607).

comparisonModels.description: Defaults for the "Compare models" bubble's picker (settings + defaults, resolved).

resetDefaultBranchCache.description: Drop cached default-branch resolutions so a retry re-reads git config.

suggestNextStep.description: Tab-completable next step for the composer placeholder; null = no obvious step.

attach.description:
Store an archive the user attached to a chat and return the reference the
agent is given. Pass `bytes` for a file dropped from outside the app, or
`path` for one already in the workspace (referenced, not copied). The
archive itself never becomes model content — see `read_archive`.

exportPdf.description: Print the tab to a PDF the user picks; resolves null when cancelled.

onPreviewStale.description: A preview server served a file that just changed on disk.

listArtefacts.description: Artefacts this thread saved in any session, newest last.

reopenArtefact.description:
Render a saved artefact again; it arrives on {@link onArtefact } like a
fresh one. False when nothing is stored under that title any more.

queue.description: Current proposed-diff queue for this thread — the pull counterpart to `onQueued`.

list.description: Installed external editors plus the sticky last-used default.

open.description: Open the active task checkout in a detected editor.

agentPrLinks.description: PRs in the active project opened by an agent this app launched (issue #690).

enableAutoMerge.description: Enable merge-when-ready (auto-merge) with the repo's preferred strategy.

invalidateReadCache.description: Drop TTL'd GitHub reads so the next list/details fetch hits GitHub (or a 304).

markPrReady.description: Mark a draft pull request ready for review.

onListsTick.description: Shared 30s list cadence from main — no-op unless this window is on PRs.

rerunFailedRuns.description: Re-run the failed workflow runs on the PR's head branch.

setListWatch.description:
Join or leave the process-wide PR-list poller. `includeMyPrs` is true once
this window has expanded "your other PRs" so ticks keep that list warm.

changeStats.description: Live +/- line totals across staged + unstaged changes, or null when clean.

committedChanges.description:
Files changed by commits no pull request carries yet, so committed work
keeps showing in the Changes panel. Null outside a repository, or when no
ref distinguishes landed from unlanded work.

committedFileDiff.description: Base → HEAD diff for one file listed by `committedChanges`.

onWorkingTreeChanged.description: Recursive execution-root change signal; consumers should debounce expensive reads.

promptState.description: HEAD commit + dirty state snapshot for a prompt about to be sent.

restoreBackup.description: Revert the session backup's captured paths to their pre-session content.

sessionBackup.description: The pre-session worktree backup taken this session, or null when none.

workingFileDiff.description: Combined HEAD → working-tree diff for one file, or null when it matches HEAD.

runDetail.description: Read the raw record behind one hook card — payload, streams, applied outcome.

test.description: Dry-run one discovered hook against a synthetic payload for its event (G2).

read.description: Trimmed contents of one discovered instruction file, for the preview dialog.

liveModels.description: Live Artificial Analysis model feed; empty models when no key stored.

listDeclared.description: Plugin-declared servers nothing is running. See {@link DeclaredMcpServer}.

resolve.description:
The first card URL that resolves for each model id, or null where none
does. Probe results are cached in the main process, so calling this for
models already looked up costs no network.

bestValueDefault.description:
Concrete model id for the plan/price Pareto best-value default
(`auto:best-value` setting expands to this on new chats / agent runs).

resolveDynamic.description:
Concrete model id a dynamic selection (`auto:…`) resolves to right now.
A pinned id is returned unchanged, so callers can pass whatever is stored.

onSwitchMode.description: When an existing pop-out is re-focused for a different pane mode.

popout.description: Detach a right-panel pane into its own window.

takePopoutSeed.description: Read (once) the pane snapshot stashed when this pop-out was opened.

addSource.description: Choose and register one plugin directory through a native host dialog.

list.description: Enumerate every registered plugin with contributions + enablement + settings values (P3).

setEnabled.description: Atomic enable/disable (P1 contract) — persists and flips the shared registry flag.

setSetting.description: Persist one plugin-scoped setting value under the manifest's declared schema (P3).

kill.description: Refuses ports Copse did not start; `reason` says why when `killed` is false.

discoverExternal.description:
List Cursor cloud agents for the account and import those matching the
given project's GitHub repo (and not already linked) as local thread stubs.
Omit `projectId` to use main's active project.

models.description: Live Cursor Cloud Agent models from `GET /v1/models` (empty without a key).

onChanged.description:
Subscribe to background roadmap changes (e.g. a complexity stamp landing
after a save returned). Returns an unsubscribe function.

availableProviders.description: Availability keyed by provider slug: fixed cloud providers + every resolved extra provider.

deleteExtraProvider.description: Remove a custom provider (or revert a preset override); returns the resolved list.

extraProviders.description: Effective extra-provider list: shipped presets merged with stored overrides/customs.

fetchProviderModels.description: List models from an OpenAI-compatible `/models` endpoint for the add/edit form.

getKeyEncrypted.description:
At-rest encryption state for a stored key: `true` = OS-encrypted, `false` =
base64 plaintext fallback (OS keyring unavailable), `null` = no key stored.

importEnvKeys.description:
Import detected environment keys into Settings for any provider not already
configured. Gated on the `envKeyAutoDetectEnabled` consent flag. With
`providers`, only those slugs are imported (unticked rows stay untouched).

modelPricing.description:
Every known per-MTok rate outside the static cloud catalog (cached
OpenRouter catalog rates merged with extra-provider rates), keyed by the
model selection string. Feeds the footer cost estimate.

refreshHuggingFaceModels.description:
Fetch the Hugging Face router catalogue and persist priced, provider-pinned
models onto the `huggingface` provider. Uses the stored/env token when none
is passed. Runs automatically when the HF token is saved.

saveExtraProvider.description: Insert/replace a preset override or custom provider; returns the resolved list.

label.description: Custom only — presets keep their locked label/base URL.

models.description: Replaces the default model shortlist when present.

scanEnvKeys.description:
Scan `process.env` and well-known shell start-up files for provider API
keys the user already has. Returns masked previews only — raw secrets never
cross IPC. Gated on `envKeyAutoDetectEnabled`; the UI records consent only
after the user explicitly chooses the scan.

onRunCommand.description: Main asked for a fresh shell running `command` (e.g. an agent sign-in).

exportArchive.description:
Zip the thread's whole on-disk directory (spine, prose, blobs, plans,
subagents) for download. The JSONL export stays the portable single-file
transcript; this is the full-fidelity copy of the store directory.

fork.description:
Seed a fork's provider-format history from the thread it branched off.
Omit `throughMessageId` (or pass the source's last message id) to copy the
sidecar verbatim; an earlier id rebuilds history from the transcript slice.

listOrphans.description: Store dirs with threads but no project entry — orphans to re-attach (#997).
